title: Glow Garden
theme: A tiny seed-creature tends a crystal garden in a deep cavern, nurturing blooms that attract light-moths to charge the heart crystal before dusk fades.
mechanics: Tap empty soil to plant a seed (spends light)
Tap seeds and sprouts to water them (spends water, speeds growth)
Blooms generate light over time and send light-moths to the heart crystal
Tap blooms to harvest them for instant light
Charge the heart crystal to the target before the dusk timer reaches zero

controls.action: Tap or click a grid tile
